  a tile draws from that many bricks per side, so walking tiles in x-order
  needs that many consecutive slabs live. It is not a tuning knob.

  NB the same LOWER BOUND caveat as the CPU column, and two more that are
  specific to this one. (1) DEVICE_PLACEMENT is still a design assertion
  rather than a reading of the code, but the executor it asserts now EXISTS
  and is bitwise the host engine at cgh64 on four GB200s (996685, 996857),
  so the placements are checked against something. What is NOT checked is
  this table at 4096^3 shapes: that is the D7 smoke.
  (2) The four-way split is charged as an exact quarter, which is right for
  MEMORY -- each card holds its quarter however the wall splits -- and wrong
  for WALL, where D5 measured 2.8-3.0x rather than 4x. Do not read a per-card
  byte here as licence for a quarter of a second anywhere.
